svg.title: LEDGERBREAKER wallpaper — Kanegura at night
svg.desc: Phone wallpaper: the vertical city of Kanegura at night, built on the white ribcage and spine of a dead god, the gold-domed Bourse at the summit in front of a red ledger-lined moon, lit windows on every rib, the Underledger fading into teal fog. Small LEDGERBREAKER wordmark.
